programme.desc: 徐彬黃暄婷主演在一家高端炊具公司擔任物流助理的活潑熱情喜悅黃暄婷飾吸引了該公司接班人Martius徐彬飾的注意他大膽僱傭了經驗不足的喜悅來現場直播他設計的一系列新炊具雖然她對這個機會感到十分興奮，但迷信的喜悅相信Martius是她的厄運魔咒，並試圖避開他但她不知道的是，冷酷的Martius特意關注自己的社交媒體，並希望幫助喜悅實現她烹飪夢想正當喜悅開始她的烹飪之旅時，Martius的公司陷入了危機喜悅會留下來幫助Martius重建他的公司嗎？冷漠而驕傲的Martius會接受喜悅的幫助並坦白自己的真實感受嗎？

programme.desc: 本片通過早期中華文明中融入石家河文化的多重視角，解析石家河遺址的歷史謎團和文化特點，以文源鼎盛儀軌歸中四個主題，闡述了以石家河古城為中心的長江中游文明融入中華文明大體系的過程，實證了長江文明是中華文明一元格局，多支一體重要體系不可分割的一部分本節目由ampampampampamplt湖北廣播電視臺ampampampampampgt贈播

programme.desc: 馬修死後，瑪麗陷入了很長時間的一段消沉期，她每天無所事事，似乎心靈也已經隨著馬修死去然而時光的腳步不會因為誰的悲傷而停下，唐頓依然是那個樓上樓下忙忙碌碌的唐頓一家之長羅伯特還是要操心唐頓的營收問題，而老太太也要關心她的孫女們，二小姐還在尋找她的幸福，湯姆則逐漸融入這個大家族，馬修的母親也必須走出喪子之痛唐頓莊園第四季將引出大量新角色，黑人演員加里卡爾將飾演Jack Ross，一名爵士歌手，在倫敦的一家高級俱樂部進行演出；大小姐的新歡Lord Grillingham將由威爾士演員湯姆庫倫飾演；朱利安歐文登將飾演年輕貴族Charles Blake；紐西蘭歌劇演員Kiri Te Kanawa將會在為大小姐舉行的派對上表演；哈麗特瓦爾特將飾演Lady Shackleton，Lady Violet的一位老朋友；瓊安娜大衛將飾演Duchess of Yeovil；奈傑爾哈曼將飾演Green，一名非常有魅力的男僕，被視作是Thomas的新對手；黛西路易斯則將飾演照顧兩個小孩子的保姆

programme.title: 四川非遺100 - 第五季
programme.desc: 四川非遺100第五季是一部具有深刻文化內涵和藝術價值的紀錄片它通過精湛的視聽呈現生動的人物故事深入的文化溯源以及對時代發展的積極回應，全方位地展示四川非遺的獨特魅力和傳承價值它不僅是對四川非遺的一次深情禮贊，更是對所有非遺傳承人的致敬，也為觀眾提供一次了解非遺感受文化魅力的難得機會

無所畏懼
programme.desc: 由熱依扎王陽啜妮沈羽潔主演故事講述羅英子熱依扎飾原本是機關工作人員，自學法律通過了司法考試，卻遭遇打擊：丈夫劉銘與她感情破裂，劉銘更在國內欠下巨額高利貸，讓羅英子深陷債務危機但羅英子並沒有放棄，她選擇用法律手段還擊羅英子作為律所新人，一方面背負著巨額債款，一方面又要面對職場上壓力，幸而她遇到了志同道合的夥伴-邱華啜妮飾夏舒沈羽潔飾她們始終堅持對法律的信仰，堅持伸張正義，通過一宗宗案件見證了人性百態和社會冷暖羅英子等人成長為金牌律師，詐騙危機也被化解

programme.title: 口述澳門歷史名人堂 II
programme.desc: 澳門，這個座落在南海之濱的小城巿，是祖國的一顆掌上明珠，也是東西方文化交織相融之地，曾有不少歷史名人在此駐足停留，對後世影響深遠口述澳門歷史名人堂2將延續第一季節目的精神，與觀眾一起探尋歷史名人們留下過的足跡，並以光影為墨以鏡頭為筆，發掘珍貴文獻素材，結合專家學者們的深度分享，記錄先賢們的卓越貢獻，打造值得代代相傳的文化經典

programme.title: 鎮鄉之寶

programme.title: 三吃客
programme.desc: 俗語說三年一代溝，除了思想和價值觀的不同，年齡的差距會不會也培養出截然不同的美食品味？美食節目三吃客，三位不同年齡層的主持人陳澍城郭坤耀童星小安與小元，就一起合力尋覓傳統和創新美食，分享他們的美食體驗

programme.title: 澳門老店傳承
programme.desc: 為慶祝澳門回歸25周年，本次將製作澳門老店傳承節目，以在澳門經營最少25年的店舖或老店，一同見證澳門一起成長的故事ampampampltbrampampampgtampampampltbrampampampgt我們會走訪不同區份的老店，一起細味熟悉的味道，當中還包括店鋪的經營方式承傳故事及周邊民生的情形，重溫幾代人見證澳門發展的點滴，並且分享回歸後到現在的改變訴說眼中的澳門，心中的家國情懷

programme.title: 아는 형님
programme.desc: 세상의 모든 질문을 그들만의 방식으로 풀어주는 아는 형님. 인생을 살다 보면 마주치게 되는 사소하지만 궁금해 견딜 수 없는 질문들. 그럴 땐 질문하라! 아는 형님이 답할 것이다.

programme.title: 광복절 특선 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 그날 이야기
programme.desc: 눈길을 사로잡는 그 날, 그 사건으로부터 한 사람의 소시민으로서 내가 느낀 바를, 온전히 나의 시점에서 주관적으로 전달한다. 너 에게 꼭 들려주고 싶어! 친구, 배우자, 동료... 세 명의 이야기꾼이 스스로 공부하며 느낀 바를 각자의 이야기 친구가장 가까운 지인에게, 가장 일상적인 공간에서 1:1 로 전달한다.

programme.title: 접속! 무비월드
programme.desc: 개봉을 앞둔 신작 중 최고의 기대작을 선별하여 소개, 각종 장르의 영화를 재미있게 비교해주며, 영화의 비하인드 스토리와 전문가의 멘트를 통해 색다른 영화보기를 제안한다.

programme.title: 런닝맨
programme.desc: 최고의 연예인들과 미션 해결과 게임을 하며 대한민국 랜드마크들을 전격 공개한다. 도심에서 벌어지는 스펙터클, 신개념, 액션 버라이어티 프로그램.

programme.title: 동상이몽2 너는 내 운명
programme.desc: 광활한 우주, 어쩌다 너는 나의 운명이 되었을까.. 사랑에 빠진 커플들, 그 속의 같고 다름을 들여다보는 영화 같은 이야기 똑같은 일이라도 남녀 입장에 따라 서로 기억의 조각이 다르다. 그래서 시작되는 이야기!

programme.title: 사장님 귀는 당나귀 귀
programme.desc: 일할 맛 나는 일터를 만들기 위한 대한민국 보스들의 자발적 자아성찰 프로그램

programme.title: 영화가 좋다
programme.desc: 틀에 박힌 영화 홍보를 거부하면서, 시청자들이 직접 참여하여 영화 속 숨은 재미를 를 보다 즐겁게 소개하고 유익한 정보를 제공하는 영화 가이드 프로그램이다. 극장가를 뜨겁게 달구는 개봉 예정작, 리뷰, 영화 음악들 감독과 배우들의 진솔한 영화 이야기까지 함께 한다.

programme.title: 신상출시 편스토랑 스페셜
programme.desc: 미식가 스타들이 혼자만 먹기에는 아까운 필살의 메뉴를 공개, 이 중 승리한 메뉴가 방송 다음 날 전국 편의점에 출시되는 신개념 신상 메뉴 서바이벌

programme.title: 불후의 명곡
programme.desc: 실력있는 후배 가수들이 불후의 명곡으로 남아있는 전설의 노래를 자신만의 색으로 새롭게 편곡하여 노래를 한다. 그 시절의 감동은 물론이며, 명곡 판정단 앞에서 노래 대결을 하며 아름다운 승부가 펼쳐진다.

programme.title: 살림하는 남자들
programme.desc: 직접 살림을 하는 남자 스타들의 리얼한 살림살이 모습과 이들의 살림 수다가 어우러진 관찰 토크쇼

programme.title: 생활의 발견 스페셜
programme.desc: 생활 속에서 직면하게 되는 때로는 간단하기도. 때로는 버겁기도 한 문제들을 해결하기 위한 살림 노하우와 생활정보, 건강, 음식 정보등 실생활에 꼭 필요한 정보들을 소개한다.

programme.title: 사랑의 가족
programme.desc: 우리의 이웃, 우리의 가족인 사회의 같은 구성원인 장애인의 삶과 희망을 진솔한 시선으로 전해주는 지상파 유일의 장애인 전문 프로그램이다. 사회에 참여하는 당당한 장애인의 삶과 모습을 조명하고 비장애인과 장애인의 소통과 나눔 및 활동등 을 소개하며 함께 살아갈 수 있는 아름다운 세상을 만들고자 한다.

programme.title: 이웃집 찰스

programme.title: 생활의 발견 스페셜

programme.title: 금수미앙
programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.desc: 군웅이 할거하고 전쟁이 끊이지 않던 남북조 시대, 북위와의 전쟁에 패한 북량의 황제는 나라를 구하기 위해 북위에 볼모로 끌려간다. 북량의 공주 심아는 천진난만하고 근심 걱정 없는 명랑한 소녀로 주변 사람들의 사랑을 받으며 남부럽지 않은 유년시절을 보내고... 아버지가 북위에서 돌아온 날, 북량은 북위 태부 집안의 계략에 의해 하룻밤 새 멸망한다. 북위의 공격에 도망치던 심아는 우연히 이미앙을 만나 도움을 받지만 이미앙은 죽임을 당하고... 자신의 인생을 모두 앗아가버린 원수와 그 일족을 무너뜨리기 위해 심아는 이미앙의 신분을 빌려 북위를 향한 복수를 시작하는데...

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 생활의 달인
programme.desc: 수십년간 한 분야에 종사하며 부단한 열정과 노력으로 달인의 경지에 이르게 된 사람들. 삶의 스토리와 리얼리티가 담겨 있는 생활 달인은 그 자체가 다큐멘터리. 비록 소박한 일이지만 평생을 통해 최고가 된 생활 달인의 놀라운 득도의 경지를 만나는 시간.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.title: 네모바지 스폰지밥
programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.title: 네모바지 스폰지밥
programme.desc: 어린이들 사이에서 최고의 인기를 자랑하고 있는 바닷속 네모난 친구는 누구일까요? 기상천외하고 유쾌하면서도 매력만점의 주인공 스폰지밥을 만나보세요! 저 깊은 태평양 바닷속, 비키니 씨티라는 해저도시에는 네모낳고 노란 해면동물 스폰지밥과 친구들이 있습니다. 스폰지밥은 애완동물인 달팽이 핑핑이와 함께 파인애플 집에 살고 있습니다. 스폰지밥의 장기는 정말 맛있는 음식을 척척 만들어 내는 멋쟁이 요리사라는 점과 언제나 모든 소동과 사건의 현장에 있다는 것입니다! 괴팍한 이웃 친구 징징이를 괴롭히는 것도 스폰지밥의 또다른 특기죠. 스폰지밥의 단짝 친구는 솔직하고 사랑스러운 불가사리 뚱이, 그리고 스릴만점의 모험을 즐기는 여자친구인 다람이입니다. 꿈과 환상의 도시인 비키니 시티 에서는 물고기 친구들이 걸어다니고, 게살버거가 가장 맛있는 음식은 이라고 하네요. 지금 바로 바닷속에 뛰어들어서 스폰지밥의 매력에 흠뻑 젖어보세요!

programme.title: Worlds Ultimate Adventures
programme.desc: Chef and content creator Julie Lin is on a Turkish adventure - combining her passion for food with history. Travelling through the south east, known as the gastronomic heart, she first stops in the city of Gazianetep - world famous for its baklava. Julie uncovers what makes this delicacy and the locally grown pistachios inside it so special. Heading further east, she visits the Neolithic site of Karahan Tepe, a discovery so significant that it is reshaping our understanding of human history. Guided by the archaeological team, Julie explores their latest finds, including what may be the worlds oldest kitchen. Her journey ends in ?anl?urfa, cooking with a family keeping traditional recipes alive, discovering the citys signature smoked pepper, and finishing her trip with a vibrant cultural, night-time celebration and an unusual raw-meat dish.

programme.title: 好事成双Alliance
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场面对婚姻职场亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活

programme.title: 春色寄情人Will Love In Spring
programme.desc: 陈麦冬年少时性格桀骜，遭遇生活变故后选择成为一名遗体整容师庄洁则因车祸致残，为了追逐更好的自己，孤身在外打拼成为大城市之中的职场精英一个是性格桀骜但身心孤独的遗体整容师，一个是身体缺陷但勇敢耀眼的医疗销售，在不断拉扯中逐渐互相理解与尊重，以爱治愈了彼此的不完美

programme.title: 下饭江湖第三季The Soul of a Meal S3
programme.desc: 下饭江湖 第三季通过食物讲述与之间紧密相连的人的故事，这群普通人活出了价值尊严自信，让观众从中获得些许勇气，同时有一种共鸣，就是每一个人都要为之奋斗的精神希望通过节目把这种平凡人的奋斗精神以及人间值得的烟火气传递给更多还在寻找生活真谛的人们

programme.title: 这一秒过火Overdo
programme.desc: Fresh from prison, Murong Qingyi is forced into a political marriage, then a stolen film reel and a gentian flower revive the lover he thought dead. At his brothers engagement, her face appears again... as his future sister-in-law.

programme.title: 这一秒过火Overdo
programme.desc: Three years earlier, anonymous letters thaw Qingyis guarded heart and lead him to Ren Susu. In the present, the woman wearing Susus face denies knowing him, while old betrayals, a prison sentence and a dangerous film reel reopen every wound.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdoms most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earths fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge Season 1
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondies love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge Season 1
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on Julys salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBois food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaskas Big Bear Challenge Season 1
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown?

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: The African savanna is an epic landscape, and whether its head-bashing hippos, hormone-crazed elephants or dueling lions, battles that rage on the savanna are just as epic.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the underwater movie capital of the world. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Stake out the Bay Familys lush territory, where matriarch Anna offers lavish feasts but faces internal dissent. Size up her rival Mia, the streetwise Townies leader whos eyeing a lifestyle upgrade, and check in with the isolated Mangrove Family.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Swim upriver with the Bay Family, where Anna offers a hand raising her grandpups before heading home to find interlopers on her turf. Watch a flood in the mangroves nearly sweep away a baby, and see the Townies eat clean through their resources.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Get ready to rumble in Marina Bay, where the Nomads and Townies are squatting while Anna and the Bay Family are away upriver. Soak up the peaceful otter life in this luxurious waterway before the surprise early return of its rightful owners.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome Annas clan back to Marina Bay, where two otter families have been trespassing. Feel the heat when Mia catches Annas scent and hustles the Townies out of reach. Then hold tight as the Nomads remain blissfully unaware of the coming conflict.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the Bay Familys matriarch as she chases the Nomads out of her territory for good, and examine the surprising birthing den where the Townies leader, Mia, settles in. Then kick back with the Mangrove Family as they pal around with stray dogs.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1
programme.desc: Chase Anna to the Townies lair, where Mia and her newborn pups are hiding out. See the babies first swimming lessons before the clan moves to new digs, and welcome an era of otter peace as the Mangrove Family becomes a parks main attraction.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. Its a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.title: Osprey: Sea Raptor
programme.desc: Wade into a saltwater marsh along the Connecticut River to witness the heartwarming reunion of two ospreys whove been mates for a decade. Witness their highs and lows over a single summer as they raise their chicks and dodge a host of predators.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1
programme.desc: Winter releases her iron grip. In Iceland Arctic foxes scurry across mountains to mate. In Shetland an otter raises her cubs. In Norway a vast reindeer herd descends to the calving grounds. A huge March storm rages across the Stormborn lands.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1
programme.desc: Experience the north Atlantics intense, brief summer with its animal residents. Follow Arctic fox cubs learning to hunt for survival, an otter pup going solo for the first time, a mate-seeking puffin, and tiny reindeer taking their first steps.

programme.title: Stormborn Season 1
programme.desc: In Iceland only one out of six cubs has survived. Abandoned by her parents, she now has to fend for herself. The reindeer herd swim two miles across open water. In Scotland, 35,000 grey seals arrive for their annual breeding season.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales play with penguins and sea lions and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard thats chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2

programme.title: SIGHT UNSEEN

programme.desc: A ruthless drug trafficking group has destroyed countless families due to drug addiction, including Zhang Yaos family. Vowing to take revenge, Zhang Yao teams up with Detective An to take down the drug lords. As their revenge plot unfolds, do they share a common foe or harbour personal agendas?

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wangs odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wangs only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: Raging Fire
programme.desc: As the police sets to arrest a drug lord, a team of masked thugs steals the drugs and murders the cops. Inspector Bong is devastated to see the aftermath of the carnage and soon discovers that the killers are led by Ngo, a former fellow cop who was forced into a life of crime by him. As the two men meet again, it is time to settle the score

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma takes on a perilous escort mission across the desert to Changan. His charge is the empires most wanted man, drawing pursuit from all sides. As rival forces close in, Dao Ma is pulled into a conspiracy that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his sons clash with another student in school and his wifes intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Death Notice
programme.desc: A serial killer leaves death notices in a city, stating when, how and who he will murder. Even if the victims report it to the police and receive protection, the killer can still break through and execute them. While the police sets up a special task force in response, they expose an even bigger conspiracy behind.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over the death of her young son by becoming a foster parent. For 13 years, Meis dedication to the foster child leads her to neglect her husband and the true needs of the child. It is only through the childs unintentional help that the couple finally manages to salvage their relationship.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit, Tian, has plotted an intense and quick armed robbery. When he encounters Hui and Shui who also plan for a robbery, they decide to team up for the heist. However, their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery has started a war with the police hot on pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: Ne Zha 2
programme.desc: After surviving the Heavenly Lightning Strike, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing persist, but their mortal forms lie in ruins. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them using the Seven-Colored Lotus, yet countless perils loom over the process. As enemies close in and fate hangs in the balance, can they reclaim their bodies and rewrite their destiny?

programme.title: OMG! Moms Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers shes unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai becomes the prime suspect in a police murder case. He takes hostages at the police station and demands to negotiate with former negotiator Jun. As the two engage in a high-stake battle of wits, their expertise in psychological manipulation leads to a tense verbal sparring match, gradually shifting their positions and mind sets.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba is forced to work at home during COVID-19 and fights with his family every day. He decides to turn his mothers chilli sauce into a trendy commodity to keep his family occupied. With his mother, father and aunt making the chilli sauce together, the family sells it online and the business grows beyond their imagination.

programme.title: Dust To Dust
programme.desc: Back in 1995, the Police successfully arrested five armed bank robbers while the two masterminds got tipped off and made a clean escape. Decades later, retired cop Wang Shou Yue is drawn back to the unsolved case when he sees a blurred figure in a news clip. A battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: True Love For Once in My Life
programme.desc: Sabrinas deep love for Andrew is shattered after his affair destroys their marriage, leaving her heartbroken. Years later, when Andrew is diagnosed with cancer, Sabrina chooses to return and care for her former husband despite the pain of the past. As old emotions resurface, she still believes true love comes only once in a lifetime.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple

In a strange neighbourhood, she hides her loneliness behind a guarded, superior attitude. Over time, however, grandfather and granddaughter grow closer, gradually opening their hearts to each other.

programme.desc: Anom, seorang pesakit mental, sering berhalusinasi tentang Mona. Suaminya, Dr. Nadeem, mengupah Farah sebagai penjaga baharu untuk memastikan Anom mengambil ubat. Farah yang terdesak bekerja, mula berhadapan dengan misteri rumah itu.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Wan Su seorang janda, mempunyai anak perempuan bernama Hanim. Dia berkahwin dengan Dato Amri seorang duda mempunyai anak bernama Irma. Bagaimanapun mereka terpisah apabila Wan Su meninggalkan suaminya dan membawa Hanim bersamanya. Kini mereka telah berkeluarga. Irma bersama Luqman dan memiliki sebuah spa kecantikan. Hanim bersama Aizat dan mempunyai seorang anak bernama Tasya. Aizat mempunyai perniagaan Food Truck. Hanim kini bekerja sebagai PA kepada Luqman. Sejak itu penampilan dan sikapnya mula berubah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Irma berjaya mengesan skandal Luqman dengan Hanim. Irma mahu meninggalkan Luqman. Imbas kembali, 9 tahun lalu semasa di kolej, Irma pernah terpikat dengan Aizat yang kini menjadi suami kepada Hanim. Wan Su datang memujuk Irma yang sedang bersedih. Irma memerlukan masa. Jerry sanggup mengeluarkan modal bagi Aizat memperkembangkan perniagaan Food Truck mereka. Di rumah, Hanim bergaduh besar dengan Aizat, dia menyalahkan Aizat kerana tidak mampu memberinya kemewahan. Hanim meninggalkan rumah.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Luqman berjaya memujuk isterinya semula. Hanim meninggalkan rumah. Tasya sedih kerana mamanya pergi begitu saja. Hanim mendesak Aizat segera menceraikannya. Aizat sedih kerana dia masih sayangkan isterinya itu. Hanim bermalam dengan Luqman yang masih bersikap buaya. Wan Su cuba memikat semula bekas suaminya. Irma mengupah orang untuk mengekori suaminya. Irma mengikut jejak Luqman ke hotel dan dia amat terkejut apabila mendapati suaminya sedang bersama dengan kakak kesayangannya Hanim.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Hanim pandai membuat cerita, kononnya Luqman membantunya tinggal di hotel tersebut selepas Aizat menceraikannya. Irma percaya dengan cerita tersebut. Wan Su tidak sukakan Aizat kerana dari keluarga yang miskin. Irma singgah makan di rumah Wan Su, Wan Su asyik menghina Aizat yang dikatakan miskin berbanding dengan Luqman. Satu hari, Irma berjumpa dengan Aizat, Aizat dikatakan memukul Hanim. Irma marahkan Aizat sehingga mahu menceraikan Hanim. Irma mengajak kakaknya tinggal bersama-sama dengannya sementara mendapat rumah baru.

Dr. Aslan telah menyediakannya sebagai ujian, ingin melihat sama ada Kenan akan menyerah sepenuhnya kepada pengaturcaraannya atau menentangnya. Melihat dia memilih kematian daripada kawalan, Aslan menyedari Kenan adalah subjek yang gagal.

programme.title: 7 Minggu Sebelum Kahwin
programme.desc: Syifa Nora Danish mengimpikan majlis perkahwinan impian sejak kecil. Namun dengan hanya tujuh minggu sahaja sebelum hari besar, pelbagai konflik dan kekacauan berlaku, dari cincin kahwin yang tidak kena bentuk hingga kad jemputan yang dicetak salah. Setiap kekusutan menggugat kepercayaan dan hubungan cinta antara Syifa dan Amar MK K Clique. Ketika tekanan bertambah, kemunculan bekas kekasih Amar Natasha membawa ketegangan besar yang akhirnya menjadi pertikaian antara mereka. Adakah Syifa dan Amar berjaya mengharungi konflik ini menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka?

programme.title: Destinasi Bajet
programme.desc: Dengan bajet yang minimum untuk penginapan, makan minum dan cenderahati untuk tiga hari dua malam ikuti pengembaraan cara destinasi bajet. Bersama Zetty Nabila, ikuti pemgembaraan ke Negeri Sembilan.

programme.title: Terbaik Dari Jalanan
programme.desc: Ikuti Suffren dan Banni dalam jelajah mereka menikmati makanan-makanan terbaik dari gerai, warung dan kedai kaki lima. Tak lupa juga, cerita-cerita jatuh bangun disebalik setiap peniaga. Untuk episod kali ini, mereka akan pergi ke N.A Chinese Muslim Cuisine, Cinnaboy Cinnamon Rolls, Chillin Grillin dan Kuey Kuey.

programme.title: Dear Hyeri
programme.desc: Eun-ho mengalami kejatuhan emosi. Dia bergelut dengan tekanan kerja dan trauma mental, manakala hubungan antara Hye-ri dan Joo-yeon semakin erat.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Aizat memberitahu anaknya Tasha, mereka akan bercerai. Wan Su menerjah Aizat, disebabkan hidupnya miskinlah Hanim melarikan diri. Irma mencadangkan kepada Luqman untuk mengambil anak angkat. Luqman tidak bersetuju. Aizat memujuk Hanim untuk berbaik semula demi anaknya Tasha. Hanim bertegas mahu diceraikan. Luqman dan Irma tiba, Luqman bertindak memukul Aizat selepas Hanim membuat fitnah kononnya Aizat memukulnya. Dato Amri berjumpa Aizat, dia bersedia membantu Aizat jika perlu. Luqman dibelasah oleh AhLong kerana gagal membayar hutang mereka.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Imbas kembali, Wan Su bersungguh-sungguh mahu Hanim menolak pinangan Aizat kerana miskin dan tiada harta. Wan Su berterusan menghina Aizat. Mulai saat itu, krisis rumahtangga mereka bermula. Kini, Hanim membuat permohoan bercerai. Skandal Luqman dengan Hanim masih berterusan. Hanim akhirnya diceraikan oleh Aizat, Tasha di bawah jagaan Aizat. Akhirnya skandal Luqman dengan Hanim terbongkar apabila Irma ternampak mereka berdua-duaan dalam bilik Hanim. Berlaku pergaduhan sehingga Luqman kemudiannya melafazkan cerai kepada Irma

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Imbas kembali 24 jam sebelum kejadian pergaduhan Irma dengan Hanim, Irma sudah pun syak suaminya apabila mendengar suara mereka berdua-duaan dalam bilik. Luqman menyesali dengan perceraian tersebut. Irma balik ke rumah bapanya dan tinggal bersama mereka. Luqman membawa Hanim bekerja di ofisnya. Aizat membawa Tasha untuk berjumpa ibunya di pejabat. Malangnya Hanim mengelak berjumpa dengan mereka. Satu hari, Irma menziarahi Aizat dan Tasha. Dato Amri diberitahu Luqman mempunyai hubungan sulit dengan Hanim.

programme.title: Khilaf Asmara
programme.desc: Dato Amri menghalau Luqman keluar dari rumahnya. Wan Su marahkan Hanim dan Luqman. Sebenarnya Hanim ialah anak saudara Wan Su. Tasha mendesak bapanya untuk berjumpa ibunya, Aizat terpaksa menipu Tasha kononnya ibunya terlalu sibuk. Irma sekali lagi berjumpa dengan Luqman, dia mahu Luqman keluar dari rumah miliknya. Manakala Aizat diberi kepercayaan untuk menguruskan perniagaan Foodtruck berskala besar dengan beberapa cawangan.

programme.desc: Dr K Usop Wilcha ialah seorang usahawan mangkuk plastik dari Perak yang sudah mempunyai empat isteri dari negeri berbeza Selangor, Kelantan, Negeri Sembilan, Sabah. Kehidupannya tenang hingga dia terlibat dengan skandal bersama Farra, seorang setiausaha muda yang bersaudara dengan ketua gangster, Cico. programme.desc: Zein pulang ke pejabat dan minta maaf dengan Ziyan. Ziyan pada mulanya mengamuk satu pejabat sebab Zein tidak muncul di majlis pelancaran album artis. Tapi bila melihat muka Zein, Ziyan terus berlembut. Zein rasa bersalah sangat dan mengajak Ziyan keluar malam itu. Apabila Ziyan tahu yang Encik Haikal mahu berhentikan Zein, Ziyan mengugut yang dia juga akan berhenti. Encik Haikal terpaksa mengekalkan Zein kerana tidak mahu kehilangan Ziyan, seorang wartawan yang bagus. Namun akhirnya Ziyan terperanjat apabila melihat banyak gambar Nilla di dalam kamera Zein!

programme.desc: Jackie, ibu tiri baru, cuba menyesuaikan diri dengan anak-anak dan hubungan dengan ibu kandung mereka, Isabel. Ketegangan, emosi, dan kasih sayang diuji ketika mereka belajar menerima perubahan dalam keluarga dan menghargai satu sama lain.

programme.title: Sifu Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Pelangi Untuk Nirmala
programme.desc: Persahabatan antara dua orang gadis, Pelangi dan Nirmala. Namun, persahabatan mereka ditentang oleh orang tua mereka kerana perbezaan strata sosial. Pelangi hidup dengan sederhana, sementara Nirmala hidup mewah.

programme.title: Saleha
programme.desc: Saleha mengisahkan seorang gadis baik hati yang ditinggalkan oleh ayahnya dan dibesarkan oleh nenek. Selepas diculik dan kehilangan neneknya, dia dipersalahkan dan dihalau oleh keluarganya. Dengan semangat dan keimanan yang teguh, Saleha memulakan hidup baru di Jakarta sambil menyembunyikan penyakit serius.

programme.title: Cosplay Deket Kamu Cintanya No Play Play
programme.desc: Rana, seorang gadis berdikari yang bekerja sebagai cosplay hantu di sebuat tempat hiburan untuk memenuhi keperluan hidup dan membayar hutang kakaknya. Suatu hari, Rana bertemu dengan anak saudara bosnya, Ezra, yang ingat Rana ingin menculiknya. Kejadian ini telah membawa hubungan mereka lebih akrab. Namun, hubungan mereka diuji oleh pandangan negatif Ibunya terhadap pekerjaan Rana sebagai cosplayer hantu.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta
programme.desc: Starla menyangka dia telah menghadapi segalanya, tetapi penipuan Niko jauh lebih mendalam daripada yang disangkanya. Ketika dia terus berusaha mempertahankan perkahwinannya, ancaman baharu muncul. Ayu, yang masih taksub dengan Niko, semakin mengikatnya dalam perangkap dengan menggunakan anak mereka yang belum lahir sebagai umpan. Pada masa yang sama, naluri Starla merasakan ada sesuatu yang tidak kena, dan dia mula diburu oleh bayang-bayang serta rahsia gelap. Dengan keluarganya di ambang bahaya dan emosinya semakin tertekan, adakah Starla mampu melindungi orang-orang tersayang? Atau adakah pengkhianatan Niko akan mendorongnya melangkaui batas yang tidak boleh kembali?

programme.desc: Pada usia senjanya, Bu Firda tidak lagi mendapat perhatian daripada ketiga-tiga anaknya, Faris, Risa dan Mira, sehingga dia ditempatkan di sebuah rumah jagaan warga emas. programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Suster El
programme.desc: Kisah seorang gadis yatim piatu bernama Elnara yang tinggal bersama kakaknya, Resti. Demi memenuhi impian Nara untuk menjadi jururawat, Resti bekerja keras. Hingga suatu hari, Resti bertemu dengan seorang lelaki kaya bernama Verdi dan mereka akhirnya menikah. Nara sangat gembira kerana perkahwinan Resti membawa kehidupan yang lebih baik untuk mereka, tetapi kegembiraan Nara berakhir seketika apabila dia menemui sesuatu yang menggoncangkan dunianya dan mengancam untuk memisahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Scam Alert!
programme.desc: The number of various scams continues to rise, with the amounts involved becoming increasingly staggering. It is reported that Hong Kong suffers an average daily loss of HK25 million, with a scam occurring every 13 minutes Scams targeting online shopping, job seeking, investment, dating apps, and telephone scams are becoming increasingly sophisticated. Citizens must raise their awareness of scams and be vigilant to avoid falling victim! Hosts Au Wing-Kuen, Edwin Siu, Lee Man-Fong, and Leung Man-Hau gather various real-life cases to gain a deeper understanding of how victims were scammed. The program will also recreate these scenarios in story form. Experts will appear to dissect different methods of committing these crimes, helping viewers identify money-grabbing traps and avoid becoming targets of scammers!

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. programme.title: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4
programme.desc: Midlife, Sing Shine! 4 has officially launched, continuing the success of the previous three seasons and once again providing a stage for singing enthusiasts to pursue their dreams. This season expands its recruitment efforts to North America and Australia, with several TVB artists participating masked, igniting the flame of music globally and illuminating the hearts of countless dreamers. Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new seasons stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of Midlife, Sing Shine! 4.

programme.title: Autumns Tale, An
programme.desc: Young and beautiful Thirteen Sister travels alone to the United States to study and live with her boyfriend Vincent. Unexpectedly, Vincent has already fallen for someone else and decided to move to Boston with his new girlfriend, Peggy. Thirteen Sister is heartbroken. One day, she nearly dies from carbon monoxide poisoning, but is saved by Boatman, who lives downstairs.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! Food anchors and hosts like Carmaney Wong,Carmen Ngai,Gillian Ng stay up-to-date with the latest culinary trends, gathering information on top-rated restaurants from various platforms. The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in Food News Report, highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new childrens program Hands Up encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot Sauce Family join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of childrens songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Forgotten Valley, The
programme.desc: Highly influenced by western culture, couple LUK SHUI-FUNG Raymond Wong and LAW KWAI-SZE Grace Chan want to reshape their feudal hometown, Ping On Valley, which has fallen so far behind, but nothing comes out as they wish. Not only are they under the tyrannical dictatorship of their father, Village Chief LUK KAM-KUK Lau Kong, who constantly stands in their way, but they are also involved in the ghost bride murder mystery, kidnapping and homicide respectively. Victims of bullying including KAM-KUKs concubines SUNG MING-FUNG Louisa So and KOO MAN-YEE Rebecca Zhu, and maid TIN CHOR-YAT Katy Kung eventually cant take it anymore. Defying the status quo in the fight for gender equality, they secretly form an alliance to protect other girls who fall victim to this. Unexpectedly, a group of wicked guys headed by butler NG SHEUNG-SHUN Louis Yuen bring in bandits for their own selfish motives. While blowing the girls cover, it also puts the relationship of SHUI-FUNG and KWAI-SZE to the test, escalating the feud between men and women

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Cantopop At 50
programme.desc: Throughout the years, countless hit songs have emerged in both Chinese and international music scenes. Regardless of the era, every work has its own devoted fans. Cantopop At 50 invites original singers or accomplished vocalists to reinterpret these once-popular classics that transcend generations, delivering high-quality musical enjoyment to music lovers. In addition to featuring influential senior artists in the music industry, the program also welcomes many singers who have not appeared in public for a long time, bringing multiple surprises to the audience.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. The program invites popular singers as guests, who personally select their favorite new and old works, perform them live, and share their favorite tracks. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: News Magazine 2026
programme.desc: News Perspective is a weekly program featuring in-depth coverage of notable news stories from Hong Kong and around the world. It focuses on social issues that matter most to Hong Kong residents and invites people from various sectors, scholars, and experts to discuss and analyze the underlying causes and developments.

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the citys structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of small spaces.

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to pass the level can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Los brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hus house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hus pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas pursuit.

programme.title: The Comedy Of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh Glass Tears, Killer Clans and Shi Szu Lovers Destiny, who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they cant escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Love Without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zangs journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sings wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her masters family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a polices son, blames his father for his mothers death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King Liu Chung-chun teams up with Goddess of Mercy Chao Li-chuan and the Dragon Girl Lung Nu to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh Ting Hua-chung,son of the Ox Demon Hung Hai-erh to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim Teng Chio-jen.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandits fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leaders daughter, Pearl. While Chuns plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the Tsai Li Fu style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yens family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the Embroidery Bandit starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: Theres no place like home.

programme.title: Puppy
programme.desc: The life of a college student changes when he finds out that his girlfriend is pregnant. He tries to find a way to communicate the news to his family.

programme.title: Gully Rowdy
programme.desc: A young man tries to find a balance between his love interest and friends. Meanwhile, his friends convince him to stay rowdy.

programme.title: Velan
programme.desc: Velan offends his powerful father Palanisamy with his privileged ways, angering the village patriarch. He falls for Ananya, a Malayali college mate, complicating loyalties and love.

programme.title: Masooda
programme.desc: A single mother Neelam and her daughter Nazia face horror as an evil force intrudes. With help from neighbor Gopi, they confront danger and persevere.

programme.title: Vellakara Durai
programme.desc: Two friends, Pandi and Murugan, borrow money from Vatti Varadhan to invest in real estate, but their plans fail when a land broker cheats them by selling a burial ground.

programme.title: Samar
programme.desc: Shankar and Roopa fall in love with each other but she suddenly ends their relationship and moves out of the country. Shankar receives a mysterious invitation from Roopa to come to Bangkok.

programme.title: CBI 5
programme.desc: After a series of murders take place one after another, a police officer decides to investigate the case himself and bring the killer to justice.

programme.title: Wolf
programme.desc: Sanjay surprises his fiancee with an unannounced visit, only to find her displeased. When a sudden lockdown traps him, he discovers her true nature.

programme.title: 風月同天第16集
programme.desc: 風月同天此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫共度風雨影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影以行動，讓愛無國界這，就是慈濟一個由無數人的小善匯聚成世界之光的故事

programme.title: 證嚴上人說法華第15集
programme.desc: 彙整歷年法藏，重現智慧法語證嚴上人說法華精選晨語開示，提綱挈領導讀法華經核心精神此經譽為諸經之王，上人致力將深奧教義化為現代菩薩道，以實踐足跡印證經文，強調不只誦經，更要行經透過濃縮法要，引領大眾深入淺出體悟教菩薩法，讓歷久彌新的法髓延續靈山感動，回歸清淨本性

programme.title: 草根菩提第3935集
programme.desc: 有一群人用他們的生活響應 證嚴上人用鼓掌雙手做環保的理念；在他們身上，環保居然可以和生活這麼地貼近，而不是遙不可及的觀念數字或儀器這是一群很特別的人，他們無時無刻都在想著如何讓我們所住的地球更美好

programme.title: 大愛真健康第700集
programme.desc: 運動是對自己最好的投資，不只是為了瘦身增肌，是為了更好的生活品質，每一天做一件對自己好的事，日子就會很踏實 運動是一輩子的事，沒時間運動不是藉口，每天花三五分鐘時間，跟著大愛真健康做運動，讓你愈動愈年輕愈動愈健康！

programme.title: 大愛午安新聞 LIVE
programme.desc: 證嚴上人慈示：新聞報導，除了報，還要進一步導，範疇要開闊，關懷普天下蒼民，為時代作見證，為人類寫歷史，大愛新聞透過SNG電話連線數位影像，傳遞全球最新訊息，堅持將人間美善訊息與人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，發揮淨化人心功能

programme.title: 志為人醫守護愛2.0第199集
programme.desc: 什麼是有溫度的醫療？什麼是醫療之魂？醫療團隊除了在診間在手術室在病房搶救生命之外，還能做些什麼？ 志為人醫守護愛帶您目擊動人的溫馨醫病情現場，透過醫療團隊的視病如親 以病為師的堅持病患與醫療團隊的互相感恩，體會與感受現代人醫如何幫助病患重拾信心，在他們人生低潮時重新出發，進而走入人群，自助助人

programme.title: 行動現場第557集
programme.desc: 愛，不漏接，做，就對了！ 臺灣社會貧富懸殊強弱失衡，現有政策與資源難以弭平，在國家發展到了一定程度後，最終希望世界大同人人平等，邁向福利理想國，但社福法規人力經費及各方資源都不足分配，無法周全，得靠民間力量自我體現，多少填補缺口慈濟志工為數甚眾，是臺灣最有組織與規模的NGO，藉由眾多的人間菩薩散布各鄉鎮村里，或許能照顧到乏人聞問的黯淡角落 我們希望提供一個行動平台，讓各方NGO團體無論大小，以及無分年紀與工作的愛心公民，參與分工這張綿密的愛心網，網住所有被制度漏接需要幫助的人

programme.title: 党良家之味第1集
programme.desc: 家貧的吳党良早年在台中清泉崗的美軍餐廳工作，學得一身好廚藝民國59年他在墾丁賓館擔任主廚，還被指定為當年的行政院長蔣經國準備餐食接著夫妻在高雄大統百貨內經營西餐廳打響名號，後來妻子不幸罹患肺腺癌過世，吳党良和兒子依妻子遺願將大體捐贈予慈濟大學妻子往生後，吳党良在師兄姊的邀約下投入志工行列，除了每天到環保站做環保，還承擔香積志工大展廚藝，發揮生命良能

programme.title: 映照人生第516集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大由印尼大愛臺製作的映照人生，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明

programme.title: 名人書房第21集

programme.title: 證嚴上人說故事第270集
programme.desc: 聽故事，曾經是兒時最大的期待好聽的故事，更是百聽不厭刻骨銘心證嚴上人說故事是證嚴上人從多年生活歷練中摘取得來的智慧結晶在一則則風趣淺白故事中，她告訴我們，在生命的經營裡，如果被名枷利鎖綁住，而失去心靈空間，那將是一種無法彌補的損失

programme.title: 風月同天第2集
programme.desc: 風月同天此語出自八世紀日本長屋王贈予唐朝袈裟上的偈語：山川異域，風月同天，寄諸佛子，共結來緣意指即使山川相隔，我們仍在同一片風與月之下，彼此牽繫共度風雨影片以這份古老而永恆的慈悲為象徵，映照出慈濟志工在全球139個國家地區持續付出的身影以行動，讓愛無國界這，就是慈濟一個由無數人的小善匯聚成世界之光的故事

programme.title: 法華經序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法華經序係花蓮靜思精舍，於每日拂曉時分，僧俗二眾的早課實錄，意在啟發自性本具的大乘精神；旨於引導大眾常行菩薩道除心無旁騖專注於當下課誦的經文外，同時擴及日常生活每一刻的專注培養慈悲佛心，學習縮小自我，破我執，達到清澄的空慧般若

programme.title: 映照人生第516集
programme.desc: 印尼，是個超過兩億人口的東南亞大國，貧富差距極大，且語言文化種族差異均大由印尼大愛臺製作的映照人生，報導當地各面向的社會議題，從2010年起逐年獲獎，被譽為是印尼正面紀錄片的先驅之一 製作團隊都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地觀點，對印尼社會做深度觀察，發現問題，報導當事人如何解決或面對，製作出一系列感人且啟發人心的故事，傳達以人道為關懷精神的節目內容 本節目記錄著印尼底層的人們，每個勇敢迎向苦難與希望的故事；也帶領觀眾看見，這個世界的黑暗角落，因為人性的光輝，所映照出的光明

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.desc: 負擔得起高價婚紗的新娘，通常認為能輕易找到心目中的理想婚紗；然而藍迪要在此告訴你，即使預算無上限的新娘，挑選夢幻婚紗也會遇上困難新娘莉亞聽從嬌寵的小妹黛娜建議，而非自己的直覺，最終空手而歸準新娘克絲汀想破守舊家人的桎梏，而一件擁有美麗細部設計的馬甲婚紗，讓她如願以償梅開二度的新娘夏奈兒適合品尼娜托奈婚紗，再次挑選相同設計師婚紗的她保證，這絕對是最後一回了新娘萊莎想挑選第三套婚紗，但是挑剔的她卻因為無法找到能勝過先前兩件的款式，因而大失所望

programme.title: 我的夢幻婚紗-有請藍迪第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 今天藍迪將告訴大家，準新娘在選購婚紗之前，必須知道哪些事項，才能順利完成任務首先你要在踏進婚紗店之前便弄清楚預算；若是你一眼愛上第一件試穿的婚紗，別擔心，這絕對是件好事挑選婚紗時，要選擇適合自己身材的版型，但是不要過度拘泥心目中的理想款式；要記住，修改或增添配件都能帶來意想不到的驚喜然而修改或增添配件都會增加費用，要預留預算空間另外要相信自己的直覺，事先和親友團討論，以免在婚紗店各唱各調，結果空手而歸

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第4季:第4集
programme.desc: 澳洲動物園接手照顧逃過森林大火的南方無尾熊，並致力要讓牠們恢復健康野生動物醫院也不眠不休，照顧四隻失去母親的針鼴寶寶

programme.title: 百變爬蟲箱第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 赫斯勒家請康乃爾世界替養了五個月的寵物髭頰蜥-奈許，依據電影大娛樂家的概念，打造一個馬戲團缸同時還替奈許添了一個髭頰蜥同伴-威斯特葛雷格想替即將小學畢業的女兒愛瑪舉辦驚喜派對，還請了店裡的爬蟲專家小傑，帶牠珍藏的爬蟲來介紹給愛瑪與愛瑪的朋友

programme.title: 炙熱非洲第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 花豹為了保護獵到的食物不被偷走，把獵物扛上樹，樹上的空氣也比較涼爽

programme.title: 珍古德-新世代
programme.desc: 聚焦世界知名靈長類動物學家與保育先驅珍古德，認識她的生命歷程與使命：新世代是人類邁向更美好未來的最大希望

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 在今天的熱血獸醫院中，傑夫要救治一隻吞了芒果核的狗高斯高斯主人帶牠到醫院之前，高斯已經連續嘔吐了二十五次傑夫醫生為高斯觸診後，發現牠的腹部有異物在照X光確認有異物後，傑夫便決定開刀取出但他在開刀後發現，異物已經到達結腸結腸內的細菌很多，如果開刀可能會造成腸胃道感染因此傑夫決定將異物推擠出來最後傑夫為高斯灌腸，並在太太佩特拉的協助下，取出高斯體內的芒果核高斯在手術後一直不吃東西，讓傑夫很擔心手術是否出了問題但高斯一看到主人後，就高興地吃起東西了

programme.title: 昆蟲之最第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 昆蟲與蛛形綱動物是大自然中最極致的生存者，劇毒偽裝空中特技蜂群般的集體智慧，彷彿擁有科幻超級英雄能力紀錄片深入牠們的野性世界，結合震撼影像與科學知識，從螳螂到蠍子，這些生物不只是令人畏懼的存在，更是演化的傑作以生物學為基礎，揭開天擇如何以最具創意令人嘆為觀止的方式，塑造地球生存之道

programme.title: 生命不受限第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 沒有水，生物便無法存活水決定了住處食物以及養育寶寶的方式有沒有水能決定動物的生死所擁有的特化技能和適應力，在極乾與極濕的環境中，動物都必須具備了不起的本領

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第12集
programme.desc: 貓是人類最喜歡的一種動物，無論是家貓還是野生的大貓，都在我們心中占有一席之地

programme.title: 可愛動物大集合第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 貓熊正面臨滅絕的危機，科學家跟愛好動物的人士在研究基地細心繁育貓熊，希望讓貓熊的族群回復穩定

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 具備什麼特徵的狗最醜？是誇張的長舌？全身皺褶？還是凹進去的臉呢？尖牙利齒的無毛犬是醜陋還是可愛？狗狗世界是男的帥女的美，不過這些優良血統中也有截然不同的族群：無毛犬短顱犬以及巨大兇猛的獒犬這群特別的狗狗就如牠們美貌的表親，同樣受人嬌寵溺愛本集的狗狗101，我們將探討一個古老問題：有些狗是不是真的醜到不行？

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集以出現在電影電視節目廣播節目攝影作品運動比賽和社群網站的名狗為主題，有些犬種透過媒體的報導而聞名全球，深入人心，名氣大增本集節目內容不僅介紹這些狗明星之所以受歡迎的原因，也介紹了牠們奢華與特別的生活方式，並記錄了牠們與飼主的互動

programme.title: 花豹天后第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 塞倫蓋提北部的濱岸林是一片緊鄰著炙熱平原的多蔭灌叢，為各種動物提供了多樣的生態棲位，這裡也是一隻母花豹的地盤，在牠的活動範圍裡，可能幾天不見牠的蹤影，接著又突然出現，奪走獵物的生命對某些森林動物來說，牠的出現就像死神突然降臨，牠來無影去無蹤，是濱岸林的神秘天后

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第3季:第12集
programme.desc: 諾曼是曾經跟史帝夫在顎劇場表演的鱷魚，現在牠已經失去全口的牙齒，幾乎無法進食，而且上顎長出莫名其妙的東西，可能是某種腫瘤或長期感染，必須全身麻醉照X光才能確定問題所在澳洲動物園年初時來了三隻漂亮的蘇門答臘幼虎，麥康莎麗和莎琪，園方訓練牠們增強自信激發親水的天性，準備跟青少虎尼爾森見面澳洲在2020年初時爆發史上最可怕致命的野火，造成超過卅億隻動物喪命，無尾熊管理員布魯克和艾登南下袋鼠島，接回三母二公幼小的無尾熊

programme.title: 鱷魚拍檔這一家第4季:第1集

programme.title: 熱血獸醫師第4季:第6集
programme.desc: 在今天的熱血獸醫院中，傑夫要救治一隻吞了芒果核的狗高斯高斯主人帶牠到醫院之前，高斯已經連續嘔吐了二十五次傑夫醫生為高斯觸診後，發現牠的腹部有異物在照X光確認有異物後，傑夫便決定開刀取出但他在開刀後發現，異物已經到達結腸結腸內的細菌很多，如果開刀可能會造成腸胃道感染因此傑夫決定將異物推擠出來最後傑夫為高斯灌腸，並在太太佩特拉的協助下，取出高斯體內的芒果核高斯在手術後一直不吃東西，讓傑夫很擔心手術是否出了問題但高斯一看到主人後，就高興地吃起東西了

programme.title: 生命不受限第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 沒有水，生物便無法存活水決定了住處食物以及養育寶寶的方式有沒有水能決定動物的生死所擁有的特化技能和適應力，在極乾與極濕的環境中，動物都必須具備了不起的本領

programme.title: 昆蟲之最第1季:第2集

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 具備什麼特徵的狗最醜？是誇張的長舌？全身皺褶？還是凹進去的臉呢？尖牙利齒的無毛犬是醜陋還是可愛？狗狗世界是男的帥女的美，不過這些優良血統中也有截然不同的族群：無毛犬短顱犬以及巨大兇猛的獒犬這群特別的狗狗就如牠們美貌的表親，同樣受人嬌寵溺愛本集的狗狗101，我們將探討一個古老問題：有些狗是不是真的醜到不行？

programme.title: 狗狗101新把戲第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 本集以出現在電影電視節目廣播節目攝影作品運動比賽和社群網站的名狗為主題，有些犬種透過媒體的報導而聞名全球，深入人心，名氣大增本集節目內容不僅介紹這些狗明星之所以受歡迎的原因，也介紹了牠們奢華與特別的生活方式，並記錄了牠們與飼主的互動

programme.title: 育空冰雪生活第4季:第7集
programme.desc: 在這誘捕季的末期，喬伊想努力多獲得一點毛皮與食物以養活家人他最後抓到一隻大狼獾，隨後前往費班克毛皮交易市場去出售，但除了賣出其他毛皮，他保留了狼獾皮，準備在為逝去好友喬治舉行的誇富宴中獻給喬治的家人與此同時喬伊的爸爸史丹也遭遇同樣收獲太少的困擾他與好友查理合作設陷阱捕捉河狸，最終獲得不少收獲，稍稍彌補今年誘捕季的低迷詹姆斯因為柴薪生意的垮台，想教兩個孩子未來生存的技巧，而指導他們如何狩獵最終小兒子喬終於獵到一隻松鼠，雖然不大但證明了他的能力最後這松鼠給了他們家的狗狗史尼克吃

programme.title: 入住阿拉斯加第6季:第8集
programme.desc: 克莉絲汀娜和威爾曾經到阿拉斯加度蜜月，並對這裡一見鍾情十年後，他們終於下定決心要帶著兩個孩子搬到這裡定居克莉絲汀娜想在這裡養雞，體驗自給自足的生活，威爾則希望能有工作坊來滿足他的嗜好，他們能否找到符合預算與需求，上班又方便的夢想住宅呢？

programme.title: 入住阿拉斯加第6季:第9集
programme.desc: 新婚夫妻麥克與潔西卡要從都市搬到阿拉斯加，他們要從三棟房子中，選出能兼顧美景又不用通勤太久的完美木屋

programme.title: 舊貨獵人第20季:第16集
programme.desc: 德魯普里察是個現代的尋寶人面對挑剔的客戶和高流通率，擁有英國最大的裝飾藝品回收場，德魯經常前往英國各地尋找被人遺棄的珍寶和古物德魯喜歡尋寶的刺激，他在缺乏建築美學的地方大肆搜刮，再帶回店裡請他的菁英修復團隊為這些古老珍寶賦予新生

programme.title: 追謎探險隊第8季:第9集
programme.desc: 喬許跟著皮爾斯保羅克里斯曼的考古團隊，繼續在蘇丹奴里潛水挖掘庫士國王納斯塔森的墓室，希望能從裂開的石棺蓋下方，找到國王遺骸存在的證據

programme.title: 層層透視古文明第5季:第16集
programme.desc: 阿拜多斯是古埃及數一數二的聖地，可謂古埃及文明的搖籃傳說歐西里斯神之墓就在此地，而與此地相關的神話又如何幫助埃及最著名也最偉大的兩位法老，塞提一世與拉美西斯二世率領埃及進入鼎盛時期？阿拜多斯神廟中列出各代法老的王名表上又為何有神秘的中斷？消失的名字背後隱藏著什麼秘密？敬請鎖定本節目

programme.title: 澳洲蛋白石獵人第8季:第19集
programme.desc: 叢林野人隊努力克服機具故障與高溫

programme.title: 澳洲黃金獵人救援篇第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在西澳州的南十字鎮，兩名探礦者克里斯和范斯面臨著開採金礦的巨大挑戰他們自製的鼓風乾燥機雖然先進，但在硬岩的礦區中一直無法找到金礦金礦救援隊兵分兩路，一方面研究硬岩採礦的可行辦法，另一方面幫他們找到了佛恩，佛恩的土地擁有金礦資源豐富的表土，可洽談合作開採經過一番談判，克里斯和范斯獲得了開採佛恩土地的權利在成功調整鼓風乾燥機後，他們在佛恩的土地上淘到了大量的金子，實現了他們的夢想

programme.title: 絕地伐木勇士第2季:第10集
programme.desc: 自古以來，伐木一直是人類生活的重要產業，時至今日，仍是世界上最危險的工作之一樹越大，風險越高...報酬也越可觀在太平洋西北地區，伐木工傑瑞德道格拉斯帶著團隊，採伐世界上最巨大最有價值的樹種之一：北美檜木但要把這些體積跟巴士一樣大的巨木，從森林運送到市場一點也不容易不僅需要高超的鋸木功夫規模龐大的機械設備，還要有在地表最嚴酷環境上工的勇氣

programme.title: 六堆客家豔陽下第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 水，是六堆的命脈，也是一切故事的起點，本集帶領觀眾穿越三百年的水文記憶與文化實踐

programme.title: 生活科技大解密第16季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集介紹船帆劍和車用兒童安全座椅超輕量船帆用單塊布片縫合而成英國皇家海軍的儀式佩劍，是在印度的造劍廠手工鑄造安全座椅在德國工廠以精準作業組裝

programme.title: 豆豆先生第113集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.title: 豆豆先生第114集
programme.desc: 在大小銀幕上扮演豆豆先生的羅文亞特金Rowan Atkinson，這次將自己變身為卡通人物，並為這部動畫親自配音！本系列忠實呈現豆豆先生這個活在真實世界的角色，每一集中，我們不幸的豆豆先生，總要大費周章弄得灰頭土臉，才能完成一件簡單的小事，那包括找停車位讓鄰居安靜下來換沙發或是曬曬太陽等豆豆先生忠實的搭檔泰迪和邪惡的房東衛奇太太，以及她的獨眼貓史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾瑪也同台演出這部卡通影集已經在全球150個國家播出，曾經榮獲過國際艾美獎和蒙特婁金玫瑰獎的肯定，並引起豆豆先生的熱潮，改編成同名電影上映

programme.title: 寶貝樂一通第3集
programme.desc: 在成為叛逆無禮的經典樂一通動畫短片前，兔寶寶太菲鴨和死黨們都還是剛學走路的小小孩，天真無邪的好奇寶寶 特別為學齡前兒童設計的寶貝樂一通將為卡通迷們隆重介紹這些可愛討喜的小小明星；節目將以較小體型甜蜜討喜的方式呈現無比歡樂的經典卡通明星兔寶寶太菲鴨傻大鳥崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充滿冒險行動的維多利亞式宅第中，可是一群鬼靈精怪的小搗蛋鬼 小兔寶寶和朋友們將邀請所有小小卡通迷，探索這個無奇不有的歡樂世界

programme.title: 世界第一等特輯第6集
programme.desc: 世界第一等是台灣八大電視大視界系列的一個旅遊節目，開播於2005年，該節目風格為探險走向，大部分節目會拜訪當地台商及移民，了解當地台商的成功經驗及與當地華僑一同探索該國家的文化和傳統世界第一等探訪世界各地稀奇古怪駭人聽聞的風土民情，首集即報導越南畸形村，創下1點多高收視率，在市場上引起不小震撼雖然這節目滿足觀眾喜歡窺視新奇事務的心理狀態，但也藉此進行人道關懷例如首集播出畸形村後，替中華民國紅十字會募得新台幣一百多萬元，製作單位之後也隨同中華民國紅十字會秘書長郝龍斌至越南捐贈該款項

programme.title: 世界第一等特輯第6集
programme.desc: 世界第一等是台灣八大電視大視界系列的一個旅遊節目，開播於2005年，該節目風格為探險走向，大部分節目會拜訪當地台商及移民，了解當地台商的成功經驗及與當地華僑一同探索該國家的文化和傳統世界第一等探訪世界各地稀奇古怪駭人聽聞的風土民情，首集即報導越南畸形村，創下1點多高收視率，在市場上引起不小震撼雖然這節目滿足觀眾喜歡窺視新奇事務的心理狀態，但也藉此進行人道關懷例如首集播出畸形村後，替中華民國紅十字會募得新台幣一百多萬元，製作單位之後也隨同中華民國紅十字會秘書長郝龍斌至越南捐贈該款項

programme.title: WTO姐妹會
programme.desc: 台灣邁向國際化，每年在台灣的外國人數也越來越多，但是這些老外的想法和生活習慣，和台灣人之間會有什麼樣的文化衝突呢？讓遊歷世界各國的主持人謝哲青和高伊玲，來和外國朋友們，互相交流討論，究竟還會激盪出什麼有趣爆笑的話題呢？

programme.title: 凶宅專賣店第1集
programme.desc: 阿澤為了妹妹欣愛的醫藥費，打算出售居住多年的凶宅，卻誤打誤撞成了義勝房屋的菜鳥房仲，這間凶宅專賣店，有著親切的中年店長雄哥舉止像流氓的勇仁零食不離手的饅頭第一天上班，阿澤獨自留在凶宅收尾整理，屋裡傳來小孩的笑聲，突然一支刀騰空而起，飛速地刺向阿澤，這時一隻嬌小的手攔截握住刀，原來是慈安堂的畢婆婆帶著有靈異體質的孫女小墨前來搭救這一群雜牌軍就這麼經營起來，更加入了新人夥伴李靜正當大夥度過一次次賣屋危機時，殊不知，背後有著更大的陰謀等著他們

programme.desc: 連年獲金鐘肯定讓主持人帶著我們沿著鐵軌公路，找尋台灣新精神費心的採訪精心構圖的畫面，帶給你感人溫馨和輕鬆歡樂，一起來看看台灣的人事物一位董事長租下七百坪大的土地移植水生植物，要保存下全亞洲最豐富的濕地生態區金瓜寮溪畔的村民約定好不抓魚，甚至組成護魚巡守隊，是為了找回一條清澈魚群豐富的河川原本種稻的六十多歲農人，為了響應農會提倡的轉型，帶著攝影機拍下大湖草莓園的技術，自己種出成功的觀光草莓園老鷹守護者沈振中說：人活著其實很簡單，只要決定一件事，去做就對了這就是新台灣的精神，在這些人身上我們看到了堅持執著與不退縮，而他們不是為了賺更多錢或個人私利，他們只為了讓台灣的每

programme.title: 來自星星的事第45集
programme.desc: 來自星星的事是一部韓國浪漫奇幻劇，以異星人和地球女子之間的愛情故事為核心劇情講述了從400年前來自外星球的千年男子都敏俊（Do Min-joon）在地球上與現代女子千頌伊（Cheon Song-yi）相遇的故事都敏俊擁有特殊的能力，包括超凡的力量不老不死和超感官知覺，但他選擇遠離人類並過著孤獨的生活然而，當他遇到千頌伊時，他的生活開始發生改變，他們之間產生了一段跨越時空的愛情劇中探討了愛情犧牲命運和人性的主題，同時也帶有一些喜劇和懸疑的元素這部劇因其精湛的演技浪漫的劇情和視覺效果受到觀眾的喜愛，成為一部受歡迎的韓劇作品

programme.title: 女王大人第1季:第40集
programme.desc: 針對最有共感的生活話題進行討論，用最趣味歡樂的方式為觀眾紓壓解憂！不僅讓女人們大吐苦水，也能讓男人們大呼過癮！

programme.title: 逃跑吧好兄弟第12集
programme.desc: 逃跑吧好兄弟是緯來綜合台來自星星的事的外景節目，節目也定位為綜藝節目靈異節目

programme.title: 來自星星的事第47集
programme.desc: 來自星星的事是一部韓國浪漫奇幻劇，以異星人和地球女子之間的愛情故事為核心劇情講述了從400年前來自外星球的千年男子都敏俊（Do Min-joon）在地球上與現代女子千頌伊（Cheon Song-yi）相遇的故事都敏俊擁有特殊的能力，包括超凡的力量不老不死和超感官知覺，但他選擇遠離人類並過著孤獨的生活然而，當他遇到千頌伊時，他的生活開始發生改變，他們之間產生了一段跨越時空的愛情劇中探討了愛情犧牲命運和人性的主題，同時也帶有一些喜劇和懸疑的元素這部劇因其精湛的演技浪漫的劇情和視覺效果受到觀眾的喜愛，成為一部受歡迎的韓劇作品

programme.title: 輕鬆養生活第3集

programme.title: 我們的日子第31集
programme.desc: 1979年冬天，在機械廠保衛科工作的王憲平，深夜巡邏時抓住了一個年紀不大的小偷憲平本準備將其送去派出所，卻被保衛科同事楊大山攔下，大山將小偷揍了一頓以示教育，便將其放走適逢廠裡新保衛科科長一職空缺已久，與副廠長談完話後的憲平，自信馬上會提幹升職，一家人都為此感到興奮本就互看不順眼的憲平與大山，終究還是起了口角，大打出手，更因為廠裡最終選擇了楊大山接管科長一位，徹底結下樑子

programme.title: 台灣百廟第333集
programme.desc: 每一座老廟，都擁有在地發展最初始的記憶；每一炷香火，都滿載鄉親里民最虔誠的心意百年來香火不斷，世代間信仰不歇，寒來暑往，流轉著許多動人的故事與傳奇台灣百廟帶您悠遊台灣各處宮廟，發現最在地的民間故事，品嚐最道地的庶民小吃，體驗最特別的民俗風情，探索最深植人心的宮廟文化給您最不同以往的行腳文化之旅

programme.desc: 在人群攘往熙來的繁華街道裡，有個老味道靜靜記錄著時間流逝那或許是來自家鄉的味道，也或許是和家人共處的幸福味道，當然也有可能是乘載夢想的味道台灣百味將帶您探索這些存在於台灣各處的味道，不僅讓您用美味一餐滿足飢腸轆轆，也用快樂的養分滋養心生命

programme.title: 台灣百廟第285集
programme.desc: 每一座老廟，都擁有在地發展最初始的記憶；每一炷香火，都滿載鄉親里民最虔誠的心意百年來香火不斷，世代間信仰不歇，寒來暑往，流轉著許多動人的故事與傳奇台灣百廟帶您悠遊台灣各處宮廟，發現最在地的民間故事，品嚐最道地的庶民小吃，體驗最特別的民俗風情，探索最深植人心的宮廟文化給您最不同以往的行腳文化之旅

programme.title: 我們的日子第35集
programme.desc: 1979年冬天，在機械廠保衛科工作的王憲平，深夜巡邏時抓住了一個年紀不大的小偷憲平本準備將其送去派出所，卻被保衛科同事楊大山攔下，大山將小偷揍了一頓以示教育，便將其放走適逢廠裡新保衛科科長一職空缺已久，與副廠長談完話後的憲平，自信馬上會提幹升職，一家人都為此感到興奮本就互看不順眼的憲平與大山，終究還是起了口角，大打出手，更因為廠裡最終選擇了楊大山接管科長一位，徹底結下樑子
